claims.statement: Assuming the repaired local scalar half-tax theorem, for every finite product-bias block A and every unit w in C^(2^|A|), H(|w|^2)+H(|(tensor_i U_p_i)w|^2) is at least sum_i(h2(p_i)-Delta(p_i)/2). Consequently J_A <= M_A + (1/2)sum_i Delta(p_i).
claims.quantifiers: every finite A; every p_i in [0,1]; every complex unit vector w; hence every genuine Boolean child family
claims.proof: Schwonnek 2018 Proposition 1 and Corollary 1 applied to the two product projective measurements, followed by the exact source block reduction
claims.endpoints: p_i=0,1 are signed-permutation factors with zero local constant; p_i=1/2 included; zero atoms use 0 log 0=0
claims.gu_implication: Discharges the all-arity uncertainty sublemma. Universal GU still needs a signed hierarchy estimate paying terminal M_A and half-taxes with single-use physical influence.
limitations: Does not prove GU or FEI
Does not cancel or bound the terminal M_A reserve
Depends on the repaired scalar half-tax theorem and exact J_A-M_A block identity
